subject: Post-call exec recap: Synthex - executive alignment & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@synthex.com>, Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@synthex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call exec recap: Synthex - executive alignment & procurement path

Thanks for taking the time today, Priya and Ethan — good to meet the Synthex leadership team. High-level recap and recommended next steps for your executive stakeholders:

Attendees: Priya Singh (Head of Data & Analytics), Ethan Rowe (CTO), Marissa Cole (AE, Redwood), Laura Bennett (Sales Ops), Aditya Rao (Solutions Eng)

Business outcomes discussed:
- Reduce customer support response time by 40% via automated triage and summarization of inbound tickets.
- Improve CSAT on enterprise accounts by surfacing model-generated resolution suggestions to agents.
- Decrease per-ticket inference cost vs current self-hosted stack by ~30% (target economics shown in attached proposal).

Top pain points / risks called out:
- Current infra is brittle during peak loads (Black Friday-like spikes).
- Data residency concerns for EU customers — need clarification on contractually scoped data flows.
- Procurement requires SOC 2 evidence and a clear SOW and purchasing path (legal + procurement review).

Procurement path & timeline suggested:
- Synthex to confirm procurement owner (Priya indicated procurement is with Finance/CFO office).
- We recommend a 6-week procurement + POC timeline: week 1-2: security review + SOW; week 3-4: pilot deployment (Dedicated capacity); week 5-6: eval & procurement sign-off.

Escalation items for executive sponsor:
- SOC 2 report and on-prem/VPC deployment option required for CFO approval. (See attached SOC summary.)
- Exec intro to CFO to confirm budget window and procurement cadence.

Immediate next steps / asks:
1) Priya: confirm procurement contact and preferred procurement timeline (by EOD Tue).
2) Ethan: share any additional technical constraints (data residency zones) so Aditya can update the SOW (by Fri).
3) Redwood (Marissa/Aditya): share tailored MVP proposal and SOC 2 summary (attached) and HubSpot deal link.

Attachments: redwood-mvp-proposal-synthex.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a compact mutual action plan once Priya confirms the procurement owner.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@synthex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@synthex.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Synthex - executive alignment & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and materials. Quick answers from our side:

- Procurement owner: Alex Morrison (Finance Ops) — alex.morrison@synthex.com. I’ll introduce you if needed, but you can expect Alex to be the primary reviewer.
- Timeline: CFO wants procurement + security review wrapped in ~6 weeks; pilot timeline sounds reasonable.
- Data residency: We need EU residency for our EU enterprise customers; on-prem or VPC acceptable, prefer VPC in eu-west-1.

I’m attaching the security questionnaire we typically send vendors. Ethan flagged that we’ll want SOC 2 and encryption-at-rest details early in the process.

Priya
Head of Data & Analytics | Synthex, Inc.
priya.singh@synthex.com | +1-617-555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call exec recap: Synthex - executive alignment & procurement path

Looping for internal alignment / exec ask. Short exec summary for GTM leadership:

Why Synthex matters: they have a strong enterprise book (financial services + EU presence) and a clear use case with measurable ROI (CSAT + ticket cost reduction). Winning this deal would be strategic for our EU coverage story.

Key asks for leadership / finance:
- Approve asking price with optional 10% promotional discount to accelerate procurement (conditional on 12-month commit).
- Approve sending SOC 2 report and proposed SOW (Aditya to finalize) for expedited legal review.
- Prepare an intro to our VPE/Partnerships to coordinate on EU-region hosting and KMS integration if Synthex requires EU key residency.

Escalation items:
- Data residency requirement (eu-west-1) — we should confirm VPC/on-prem feasibility with infra immediately.
- Procurement owner (Alex Morrison) prefers a single consolidated SOW and one vendor contact.
- Timeline: they want procurement + pilot done in ~6 weeks; we should reserve Dedicated capacity for a 2-week pilot window.

Marissa — recommend you set a short call with Alex + CFO next week. If you want, I can join the CFO intro to help unblock procurement.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@synthex.com>, Alex Morrison <alex.morrison@synthex.com>
Cc: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@synthex.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Synthex - executive alignment & procurement path

Thanks, Priya — and welcome Alex. Very glad we’re aligned on timeline and residency. Quick mutual action plan and owners (I’ll track in HubSpot):

Action items:
1) Alex (Synthex) — share preferred procurement checklist and any PO template (due: 2027-05-28).
2) Aditya (Redwood) — produce final SOW with eu-west-1 hosting option and KMS notes; include SOC 2 appendix (due: 2027-05-27).
3) Marissa (Redwood) — draft a 2-week Dedicated pilot statement of work and cost estimate + HubSpot deal update (due: 2027-05-26).
4) Laura (Redwood) — standby for CFO intro; help coordinate legal review (target: 2027-06-04).

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/RDW-2027-1043) | Drive folder for artifacts (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/synthex-eval)

Next meeting: propose 30-min intro with Alex + CFO next Tue 2027-05-31 10:00am ET — does that work for Synthex?

Thanks all — attaching the SOW draft and SOC 2 summary for quick review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
